scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF請稍等！你現在攜帶的物品太多了。先把一些物品存進卡普拉倉庫，再回來^000000吧。

scripts.text: Heh heh, you're a boy, so you probably don't like dolls, right? Well, I like dolls very very much!
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，你是男孩子，應該不喜歡娃娃吧？我可是超級喜歡娃娃的！

scripts.text: Hi hi~! Oh, oh, do you like dolls? I really really like dolls... Hee Hee~!
scripts.translation: 嗨嗨~！哦，你喜歡娃娃嗎？我真的特別喜歡娃娃...嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: You know, I really really want a new doll! I hope my daddy will give me one on my birthday...!
scripts.translation: 你知道嗎，我真的好想要一個新娃娃！希望爸爸能在我生日時送我一個...！

scripts.text: Um, I hope your daddy gives you one too.
scripts.translation: 嗯，希望你爸爸也送你一個。

scripts.text: How about I give you one now?

scripts.translation: 我希望爸爸送我一隻溜溜猴娃娃。

scripts.text: Maybe you should put some of your stuff away first, you look like you're carrying too much, hee hee~
scripts.translation: 也許你該先把一些東西收起來。看起來你帶的東西太多了，嘿嘿~

scripts.text: Do you always carry so much with you? Put some of your things away first, okay?
scripts.translation: 你總是帶這麼多東西嗎？先收起一些，好嗎？

scripts.text: What kind of doll are you going to give me? Are you really gonna give me one?
scripts.translation: 你要送我什麼娃娃？你真的會送我嗎？

scripts.text: I'm as adorable as a doll.

scripts.translation: 我已經有好多波利娃娃了...

scripts.text: But since a cute boy is giving it to me, I'll happily take it! Hee hee, soft and fluffy Poring doll~
scripts.translation: 不過，既然是可愛的男孩子送我的，我就收下啦！嘻嘻，軟綿綿的波利娃娃~

scripts.text: But since a nice girl is giving it to me, I'll take it! Hee he, soft and fluffy Poring doll~
scripts.translation: 不過，既然是好心的女孩送我的，我就收下啦！嘻嘻，軟綿綿的波利娃娃~

scripts.text: Ooh, let me give you something as a little thank you. You see, I hid some candy so I can eat it without telling mommy.
scripts.translation: 哦，讓我送你點小禮物表示感謝吧。你看，我藏了些糖果，這樣就能不告訴媽媽，偷偷吃掉。

scripts.text: I don't know if you're too old to like candy, but I guess it's okay.
scripts.translation: 不知道你是不是嫌糖果太幼稚了，不過應該沒關係吧。

scripts.text: So, try not to eat too much, okay? Otherwise, you might get in trouble!
scripts.translation: 不過別吃太多，好嗎？不然會惹麻煩的！

scripts.text: You're not making fun of me are you?
I guess you forgot it somewhere...
scripts.translation: 我想你是把它忘在哪兒了...

scripts.text: But since... You're... Such a nice guy... I better take it...!
scripts.translation: 不過...既然...你是個好人...我還是收下吧...！

scripts.text: But since... Since it's a gift... I guess I'll take it...
scripts.translation: 既然...既然是禮物...那我就收下吧...

scripts.text: If you eat too much, your teeth will start to rot... at least, that's what Mommy says.
scripts.translation: 吃太多的話，牙齒會爛掉...至少媽媽是這麼說的。

scripts.text: Chonchon dolls are ugly anyways, but you still lied to me! How can you be so mean?!
scripts.translation: 蒼蠅娃娃本來就很醜，可你居然還騙我！你怎麼能這麼壞？！

scripts.text: I really like this Puppet~ Heh hehe! Thank you so much~
scripts.translation: 我真的很喜歡這個木偶~嘿嘿！太感謝你了~

scripts.text: Here it is! It's some of the candy Santa gave me. Go ahead and try some! Oh, and thank you so much for the doll!
scripts.translation: 找到了！這是聖誕老人給我的糖果。快嚐嚐！哦，還有，太感謝你送我的娃娃了！

scripts.text: Awww, you were only kidding? W-W-Why are you teasing me like that?
scripts.translation: 哎呀，你只是開玩笑嗎？為...為什麼要這樣捉弄我？

scripts.text: It's the Rocker that likes singing and dancing! I don't like grasshoppers, but I like this because it's cute~
scripts.translation: 就是那個喜歡唱歌跳舞的搖滾蝗蟲！我不喜歡蝗蟲，不過這個娃娃好可愛~

scripts.text: Hmmm, I should give you something too, huh? Let's see, I have what my grandpa gave me...
scripts.translation: 嗯嗯，我也該送你點東西，對吧？讓我看看，爺爺給我的東西還有...

scripts.text: Here you go! We have a lot of this at home, so I'll give it to you, okay? Oh, and thank you so much for the doll~ I love cute dolls!
scripts.translation: 給你！家裡有很多這個，分你一些吧？哦，還有，太感謝你送我的娃娃了~我最喜歡可愛的娃娃！

scripts.text: I was so excited about it, too...

scripts.translation: 媽媽今天也逼我吃蘑菇了.

scripts.text: But this doll is cute, so I'll take it. But I'm still not gonna eat mushrooms! Heh heh~
scripts.translation: 不過這個娃娃很可愛，我就收下啦。但我還是不吃蘑菇！嘿嘿~

scripts.text: Hehe~ My mommy made this! It's really yummy. I love cookies, too. So try it, you'll like it! Hee hee!
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿~這是媽媽做的！真的很好吃。我也喜歡餅乾，快嚐嚐，你一定會喜歡的！

scripts.text: I've never seen a doll like this before. Where it's from? Hmm? Since I've never seen this kind of doll before, I'm gonna show it to my daddy, too. Hehe~! He'll be surprised!
scripts.translation: 我從沒見過這樣的娃娃。它是從哪裡來的？嗯...我也要拿給爸爸看看。嘿嘿~他一定會大吃一驚！

scripts.text: Here, since you gave me such a nicely made doll, I better give you something good too.
scripts.translation: 給你，既然你送了我這麼精緻的娃娃，我也該回贈你點好東西。

scripts.text: I found it when I secretly went to the forest. I took it because it has pretty colors!
scripts.translation: 這是我偷偷去森林時發現的，因為顏色漂亮就帶回來了！

scripts.text: Since there's two, you can share it with your girlfriend. Hee hee~!
scripts.translation: 既然有兩個，你可以和女朋友分一個哦。嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: Since there's two, you can share it with your boyfriend. Hee hee~!
scripts.translation: 這是我偷偷去森林時發現的，因為顏色漂亮就帶回來了！既然有兩個，你可以和男朋友分一個哦。嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: It's so weird. It's cute but it's also scary at the same time. Well, since you gave me a pretty doll, I wanna give you something, too.
scripts.translation: 真奇怪，既可愛又有點嚇人。不過既然你送我這麼漂亮的娃娃，我也想送你點東西。

scripts.text: My daddy gave me this when I was really sick. I'm not sick anymore so you can use it when you need to. Hehehe~
scripts.translation: 我以前病得很重時，爸爸把這個給了我。現在我已經好了，你需要的時候可以用它。嘿嘿~

scripts.text: the doll. I won't lose it!
scripts.translation: 我會好好保管，不弄丟的！

scripts.text: You big liar! Why are you pretending to be nice?!
scripts.translation: 你這個大騙子！為什麼要假裝對我好？！

scripts.text: Here, let me give you some cake my grandma made. It's really yummy. I don't know if you like sweets or not, but it's really good! Please try some!
scripts.translation: 給你，嚐嚐奶奶做的蛋糕。真的很好吃。我不知道你喜不喜歡甜食，但這個絕對美味！快嚐嚐！

scripts.text: Hey! How come you have to say things like that? Are you making fun of me?!
scripts.translation: 嘿！為什麼要說這種話？你是在捉弄我嗎？！

scripts.text: A Yoyo doll! It's so pretty! You're really gonna give it to me?! Yay! Thank you so much! I really like it! Hee hee!
scripts.translation: 溜溜猴娃娃！好漂亮！你真的要送給我嗎？！太好了！非常感謝！我好喜歡！嘿嘿！

scripts.text: My daddy picked it up on his way to another town. It looks like some kind of seed. I tried planting it in front of our house but it won't grow. Do you want to try?
scripts.translation: 這是爸爸去別的城鎮時撿到的，看起來像顆種子。我試著種在家門口，可它不發芽。你想試試嗎？

scripts.text: How come you're making fun of me?!
I'm as adorable as a doll...
Some may say I've lived a full life on wine, women and song...
scripts.translation: 也許有人會說，我這一生都過得有滋有味，酒、美人、歌聲樣樣不缺...

scripts.text: But my soul still burns with youthful vigor! It's just... This old body can't keep up anymore... *Hack! Wheeeeze~*
scripts.translation: 可我的靈魂依然燃燒著青春的活力！只是...這副老骨頭再也跟不上了...*咳！喘...喘不上氣~*

scripts.text: That's Tiger's Footskin!! Even from here I can feel its powers!
scripts.translation: 那就是虎掌！！光是看著，我都能感受到它的力量！

scripts.text: One glance at it can restore your strength, one sniff and your blood boils with vigorous pleasure...
scripts.translation: 看一眼就能恢復體力，聞一下就讓人熱血沸騰、活力四射...

scripts.text: Will revive my virility!!!! The Tiger's Footskin~!! Ohhhh! Ohh My God !! Please!!! Please give me that... Please...
scripts.translation: 我就能重振雄風！！虎掌~！！噢噢！天哪！求求你，把它給我...求求你...

scripts.text: With this I can revive my youthful splendor!! I must eat this thing right away !
scripts.translation: 有了它，我就能重現年輕時的風采！我得馬上吃掉它！

scripts.text: If anything, I feel even worse. Th-there's this buzzing in my head...
scripts.translation: 甚至更糟了。頭...頭裡嗡嗡作響...

scripts.text: You've got to take care of yourself as well as your can. Without your health, one cannot enjoy the pleasures of this mortal realm.
scripts.translation: 你要好好照顧自己。沒有健康，就無法享受人世間的樂趣。

scripts.text: In order to restore my youth, I tried all sorts of things, mostly by hearsay, but nothing worked. In the end, I spent so much zeny on miracle cures, I ended up broke.
scripts.translation: 為了恢復青春，我試過各種辦法，大多是聽別人說的，可全都沒用。最後我花光錢買靈丹妙藥，徹底破產了。

scripts.text: I've mostly given up on restoring my youth. But there is one hope left... Eating ^3355FFTiger's Footskin^000000, The King of Invigorators!!
scripts.translation: 我差不多放棄恢復青春了，但還剩一絲希望^3355FF...吃虎^000000掌，活力之王！！

scripts.text: Haven't you heard?! One glance would restore the color in my white hair, one sniff, even just one touch, and an 80 year-old would have another chance at youth... It's The King of Invigorators !
scripts.translation: 你沒聽說過嗎？！看一眼就能讓白髮恢復光澤，聞一下，甚至只要摸一下，八十歲的人也能重獲青春...那可是活力之王！

scripts.text: I wish I could eat 10 Tiger's Footskin. Then, I wouldn't have to die!
scripts.translation: 真想吃掉10個虎掌。那樣我就不用死了！

scripts.text: If someone helped me get them, I would give that person my precious item, ^3355FFBoys Cap^000000 without regret...
scripts.translation: 誰要是幫我弄到它們，我就毫不猶豫地把珍藏^3355FF的男孩帽^000000子送給他...

scripts.text: What do you think about animal horns? Oh man, I think they're great! Don't you? I love animal horns so much I became a ^3355FFHorn Collector^000000.
scripts.translation: 你覺得動物的角怎麼樣？我覺得它們棒極了！你不覺得嗎？我喜歡角喜歡^3355FF到成了角收藏^000000家。

scripts.text: I mean, there's so many things you can do with horns. You can wear them on your head, you can wear them on, um... your house? All sorts of things!
scripts.translation: 角的用途可多了。能戴在頭上...或者，呃...戴在房子上？總之什麼都能用！

scripts.text: I've collected almost every sort of horn except for one kind, and that's ^FF3355Evil Horn^000000. Some people say Evil Horn doesn't even come from an animal, but from a demon. But even so, I still want it.
scripts.translation: 我幾乎收集了所有種類的角，只差一種^FF3355：邪惡之^000000角。有人說那不是動物的角，而是惡魔的角。可我還是想要。

scripts.text: If you offer me 20 Evil Horns, I will give you an ^3355FFAntler^000000 from my precious collection. So, deal?
scripts.translation: 給我20個邪惡之角，我就^3355FF從珍藏^000000裡送你一個鹿角。成交嗎？

scripts.text: Whoah~! This is the first time I've ever seen a real ^FF3355Evil Horn^000000!!
scripts.translation: 哇~！我第一次見到真正的^FF3355邪惡之角^000000！！

scripts.text: Thank you! Here, this is my Antler for you!
With your great help, I can make my wish come true this time. Finally, I'll be recognized as a serious horn collector. I appreciate this~!
scripts.translation: 多虧你的幫助，我終於能實現願望了。大家總算會承認我是個真正的角收藏家。太感謝了~！

scripts.text: You don't seem to have enough. I need ^FF335520 Evil Horns^000000 for my collection.
scripts.translation: 你好像不夠。我還^FF3355需要20^000000個邪惡之角。

scripts.text: Well that's fine. Although you're a rude prick, I will forgive you. We'll probably speak again...
scripts.translation: 好吧，沒關係。雖然你這傢伙有點粗魯，我還是原諒你。我們以後大概還會再見...

scripts.text: I know I know, you just want to get a Bao Bao of your own. But I can't concentrate on my work if you keep rushing me like this.
scripts.translation: 我知道，我知道，你想要個丸子頭飾。可你一直催我，我就沒法專心幹活。

scripts.text: Now make good use of it!!
Alright alright! Gosh, your Crescent Hairpin will be ready in a bit, but I can't concentrate my work if you keep rushing me like this!
scripts.translation: 好好好！天哪，你的彎月髮夾馬上就做好了。可你一直催，我根本沒法專心！

scripts.text: Yeah yeah, you came for your Fashionable Glasses. Just don't rush me, or I won't be able to concentrate on my work, alright?
scripts.translation: 行行行，你是來拿時尚眼鏡的。別催我，不然我沒法專心幹活，好嗎？

scripts.text: Now go wear these and look, well, as fashionable as these glasses, I guess.
scripts.translation: 戴上它，想必會顯得...嗯，很時尚吧。

scripts.text: Okay okay, you want your Heart hairpin, I'm working on it. Yeesh, I can't concentrate at all if you try to rush me, you know?
scripts.translation: 好好好，你要愛心髮夾，我正在做呢。哎呀，你一催我就沒法專心了，知道嗎？

scripts.text: Awww man. Can't you tell I'm on vacation? All I wanted was some peaceful rest.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，看不出我在度假嗎？我只想安安靜靜休息一會兒。

scripts.text: Okay okay, you win. Once again, my reputation as a master craftsman precedes me.
scripts.translation: 好吧好吧，你贏了。看來我這位名匠的名聲還真是響亮。

scripts.text: Let me know what item you're interested in, and maybe I'll make it for you...
scripts.translation: 告訴我你想要哪件東西，也許我會幫你做...

scripts.text: You want me to make you a Bao Bao, huh? Alright, alright...
scripts.translation: 你想讓我給你做一個丸子頭飾，是嗎？好吧，好吧...

scripts.text: So you want a Crescent Hairpin, huh? Man, I guess these things are pretty high in demand.
scripts.translation: 所以你想要彎月髮夾？天哪，看來這東西還挺搶手的。

scripts.text: Weird. How'd you know I make Fashionable Glasses? I guess I must be more famous that I thought.
scripts.translation: 奇怪，你怎麼知道我會做時尚眼鏡？看來我比自己想像的更有名。

scripts.text: You want a heart hairpin, eh? Okay, I think I can work something out for you...
scripts.translation: 你想要愛心髮夾？好吧，我想辦法給你做一個...

scripts.text: Ah, such a cool breeze. It's good to visit the seashore. I think it was the right choice to come here to take a break from my business.
scripts.translation: 啊，海風真涼快。來海邊真好，我覺得暫時放下生意來這裡度假是正確的選擇。

scripts.text: Ooh, the sun is too strong today. I'm glad that I brought my hat. I'm going to get a sunburn if my skin is exposed to the sun like this everyday.
scripts.translation: 今天太陽真毒。幸好我帶了帽子，不然每天這樣曬，皮膚都要曬傷了。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm sooo thirsty! A nice, chilled Yellow Potion would be perfect right about now~
scripts.translation: 啊，我好渴！現在來一瓶冰鎮黃色藥水就太棒了~

scripts.text: Let me treat you to a Yellow Potion.
scripts.translation: 我請你喝一瓶黃色藥水吧。

scripts.text: What, you expect me to give you one?!
scripts.translation: 什麼，你還指望我送你一瓶？！

scripts.text: Ah, thank you so much. I'm so glad to have met a friendly person like yourself.
scripts.translation: 啊，太感謝了。能遇到像你這樣友善的人真好。

scripts.text: ^0000FFMagician Hat^000000 and more in my room.
I brought these hats so I can sell them and use the money for my vacation here, but now it looks like I have to wear one~
scripts.translation: 我本來帶了這些帽子來賣，想用賺的錢度假，看來現在得自己戴一頂了~

scripts.text: Oh? Didn't you know? I'm a hat merchant. Didn't I tell you that before?
scripts.translation: 哦？你不知道嗎？我是賣帽子的。之前沒告訴過你嗎？

scripts.text: Hmm, I guess I didn't. I apologize. Ooh! You know what, I could make you a Sunday Hat~!
scripts.translation: 嗯，看來我沒說過，抱歉。噢！不如我給你做頂週日帽吧~！

scripts.text: You have all the items already? If there are forged items or slotted items with monster cards, then put them into your storage.
scripts.translation: ！你已經有所有材料了？如果有精煉過的裝備或插了魔物卡片的裝備，請先存進倉庫。

scripts.text: I just want to make something for the Yellow Potion, so I won't charge you any zeny for my hat making service.
scripts.translation: 我只是想回報你那瓶黃色藥水，做帽子不收你一分錢。

scripts.text: Alrighty. Just give me a moment...
How about that? Do you like it?
Once again, thank you for your favour. I'll see you later~
scripts.translation: 再次感謝你幫忙。下次見~

scripts.text: If by any chance you visit me later, I'd be more than happy to make a hat for you~
scripts.translation: 以後再來找我，我很樂意為你做頂帽子~

scripts.text: I will tell you a secret, because you gave me the Yellow Potion~
scripts.translation: 你給了我黃色藥水，我就告訴你一個秘密~

scripts.text: I'm looking forward seeing you again~~
Oh? Didn't you know? I'm a hat merchant. Didn't I tell you that before?
scripts.translation: 哦？你不知道嗎？我是帽子商人。我之前沒告訴過你嗎？

scripts.text: Hmm, I guess I didn't. I apologize. Ooh! You know what, I could make you a Mage Hat!
scripts.translation: 嗯，看來我還沒告訴過你，抱歉。噢！不如我給你做頂魔術師帽吧！

scripts.text: You have all the items already? If there are forged items or slotted items with monster cards, then put them into your storage.
scripts.translation: ！你已經有所有材料了？如果有精煉過的裝備或插了魔物卡片的裝備，請先存進倉庫。

scripts.text: I just want to make something nice for you, so I won't charge you any zeny for my hat making service.
scripts.translation: 我只是想送你一件好東西，所以這次做帽子不收你Zeny。

scripts.text: Alrighty. Just give me a moment...
Once again, thank you for your favour. I'll see you later~
scripts.translation: 再次感謝你的惠顧。下次見~

scripts.text: If by any chance you visit me later, I'd be more than happy to make a hat for you~
scripts.translation: 如果你之後再來找我，我會非常樂意為你製作一頂帽子~

scripts.text: I will tell you a secret, because you gave me the Yellow Potion~
scripts.translation: 因為你給了我黃色藥水，所以我要告訴你一個秘密~

scripts.text: I'm looking forward seeing you again~~
Oh? Didn't you know? I'm a hat merchant. Didn't I tell you that before?
scripts.translation: 哦？你不知道嗎？我是帽子商人。我之前沒告訴過你嗎？

scripts.text: Hmm, I guess I didn't. I apologize. Ooh! You know what, I could make you a Magician Hat!
scripts.translation: 嗯，看來我還沒告訴過你。抱歉。噢！你知道嗎，我可以為你製作一頂魔術師帽！

scripts.text: You have all the items already?
scripts.translation: 你已經擁有所有材料了？

scripts.text: If there are forged items or slotted items with monster cards, then put them into your storage.
scripts.translation: 如果有鍛造過的物品或鑲嵌了魔物卡片的物品，請把它們放入倉庫。

scripts.text: I just want to make something nice for you, so I won't charge you any zeny for my hat making service.
scripts.translation: 我只是想為你做點好的，所以我的制帽服務不收你任何Zeny。

scripts.text: Alrighty. Just give me a moment...
Once again, thank you for your favour. I'll see you later~
scripts.translation: 再次感謝你的惠顧。下次見~

scripts.text: If by any chance you visit me later, I'd be more than happy to make a hat for you~
scripts.translation: 如果你之後再來找我，我會非常樂意為你製作一頂帽子~

scripts.text: I will tell you a secret, because you gave me the Yellow Potion~
scripts.translation: 因為你給了我黃色藥水，所以我要告訴你一個秘密~

scripts.text: I'm looking forward seeing you again~~
Well, the hats I have with me are for my customers. If I use them for myself, I'll have nothing to sell...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我手邊的帽子是賣給顧客的。如果我自己用了，就沒什麼可賣的了...

scripts.text: I want to make something special for you because you showed me such kindness, but I don't have anything like that right now.
scripts.translation: 你對我這麼好，我想為你做點特別的東西，可惜現在沒有合適的材料。

scripts.text: I think I can make a special item from the items you already have.
scripts.translation: 我想可以用你現有的材料做一件特別的物品。

scripts.text: If there are any forged items or slotted items with monster cards, then put them into your Kafra storage.
scripts.translation: 如果你有精煉過的裝備，或插了魔物卡片的裝備，請先存進卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text: I think I'll make you a Hat of the Sun God~
scripts.translation: 我想為你製作一頂太陽神頭盔~

scripts.text: Haha, I made this quicker than the speed of light!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，我做得比光速瞬移還快呢！

scripts.text: ...Or maybe I just gave you the one I already had, and took your items. Hee hee!
scripts.translation: ...或者我只是把早就做好的給你，然後拿走了你的材料。嘿嘿！

scripts.text: Anyway, I justed want to give something really nice to you...
scripts.translation: 總之，我就是想送你一件好東西...

scripts.text: If you have these, I can make you my fantastic 'Hat of the Sun God!'
scripts.translation: 如果你有這些材料，我就能為你製作出我引以為傲的“太陽神頭盔”！

scripts.text: I just want to make something really special for you, so I won't charge you any zeny to make this hat.
scripts.translation: 我只是想為你做點特別的東西，所以製作這頂帽子不收你任何Zeny。

scripts.text: Umm, I appreciate it but, I guess you just ran out of Yellow Potions?
scripts.translation: 嗯，我很感激，不過...你是不是黃色藥水用完了？

scripts.text: What does a man have to do to get a stiff drink around here? I mean, there are absolutely no good bars in Alberta!
scripts.translation: 一個男人要怎樣才能在這裡喝上一杯烈酒？艾爾貝塔根本沒有像樣的酒吧！

scripts.text: Well, the alcohol in the pub here is second rate, but I gotta admit, it's got a great atmosphere.
scripts.translation: 這裡酒館的酒質量一般，不過氛圍倒是很不錯。

scripts.text: In fact, this old man is always there, telling stories about Turtle Island! But we're not sure if he's been there, or if he's just that drunk.
scripts.translation: 那邊總有個老人講海龜島的故事！不過我們不確定他真的去過，還是喝多了在吹牛。

scripts.text: Hey, your eyes just lit up right when I said 'Turtle Island!' Hmm, let me try that again.
scripts.translation: 嘿，我一提到“海龜島”，你的眼睛就亮了起來。嗯，讓我再試一次。

scripts.text: You must be an adventurer. It seems like you really wanna learn more about that place, huh?
scripts.translation: 你一定是位冒險者。看來你真的很想多瞭解那個地方，是嗎？

scripts.text: Why don't you look around near the pub, and look for that old man? He's usually pretty drunk, and speaks nonsense, but he might have something to say to you.
scripts.translation: 你不妨去酒館附近轉轉，找找那位老人。他通常喝得爛醉，說話顛三倒四，但也許對你有些話要說。

scripts.text: Oh, and um, I've been in his room before. He leaves some sort of letter lying around the table that has something to do with his Turtle Island stories.
scripts.translation: 哦，對了，我之前去過他的房間。他在桌子上留了一封信，似乎與他關於海龜島的故事有關。

scripts.text: But if he asks for you to buy him a drink, I wouldn't do it. He's got like, three extra livers or something, so he'll drink you to bankruptcy.
scripts.translation: 不過要是他讓你請喝酒，最好別答應。他酒量驚人，能把你喝到破產。

scripts.text: Yeah, I guess it's pretty cool listening to his stories. But it would be even cooler if I could hear them in a better drinking establishment.
scripts.translation: 嗯，聽他講故事確實挺有意思的。但如果能在一家更好的酒館裡聽，那就更棒了。

scripts.text: I mean, they don't even serve a 'Boogieman,' much less a 'Cobo.' It's getting harder and harder to find those fine, fine specialty drinks.
scripts.translation: 我是說，他們連“鬼魂”都不賣，更別提“科博”了。那些上等的特色酒越來越難找了。

scripts.text: There isn't one decent drinking establishment in all of Alberta! But then again, why did I drink so much? Hmm...
scripts.translation: 整個艾爾貝塔竟然沒有一家像樣的酒館！不過話說回來，我為什麼喝那麼多呢？嗯...
告訴我關於海龜島的事

scripts.text: Well, there's a lot of folklore about that place. Some folk say that there's a mountain of treasure there.
scripts.translation: 嗯，關於那個地方有很多傳說。有人說那裡有一座寶藏山。

scripts.text: Others folk say a potion that can prolong your lifespan can be found somewhere in Turtle Island. But nobody really knows for sure.
scripts.translation: 還有人說，在海龜島的某個地方能找到一種能延長壽命的藥水。但沒人能確定。

scripts.text: But I'm sure that Turtle Island does exist, and that something wonderful can be found there.
scripts.translation: 但我確信海龜島是真實存在的，而且那裡一定藏著美好的事物。

scripts.text: But only someone with a good heart that's eager for adventure should be able to go to that kind of place.
scripts.translation: 不過，只有心地善良且渴望冒險的人，才能前往那樣的地方。

scripts.text: I like the shine in your eye, my boy! I can see a little bit of myself in those eyes. Yes...
scripts.translation: 我喜歡你眼中的光芒，孩子！我在你眼中看到了年輕時的自己。是的...

scripts.text: No use hiding the glint in your eyes, my dear! It's adventure you wish for, that much I can tell...
scripts.translation: Ha ha ha~!~！別想掩飾你眼中的光芒，親愛的！你渴望冒險，這一點我看得出來...

scripts.text: Have you heard of a man named ^3355FFJornadan Niliria^000000? He, and a group of ten other men actually found Turtle Island!
scripts.translation: 你聽說過約爾納丹^3355FF·尼利里亞嗎^000000？他和另外十名船員一起發現了海龜島！

scripts.text: ^3355FFJornadan Niliria^000000 was a man of strength and conviction. He and his crew gathered every clue they could about Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF約爾納丹·尼利^000000里亞是個堅強又有信念的人。他和船員們蒐集了所有關於海龜島的線索。

scripts.text: Even after learning all that they could, much of their voyage relied on their hope and faith that the Turtle Island legend was true...
scripts.translation: 即使蒐集到所有線索，他們仍只能懷著希望與信念出航，賭海龜島的傳說是真的...

scripts.text: After a long, arduous journey, their efforts were rewarded, and they landed on Turtle Island!
scripts.translation: 經過漫長艱辛的旅程，他們終於有了回報，成功登上海龜島！

scripts.text: However, it gets more complicated after that. I hear Niliria's crew had great difficulty getting back home for some reason.
scripts.translation: 不過之後的事就複雜了。我聽說尼利里亞的船員不知為何很難回家。

scripts.text: If you want to learn more, why don't you go to the eastern end of the Alberta port? There's a scholar there that knows more of this story.
scripts.translation: ..想了解更多的話，就去艾爾貝塔港東邊找那位學者。他更瞭解這個故事。

scripts.text: He could probably shed more light on the subject of Turtle Island's legend.
scripts.translation: 他應該能為你揭開更多海龜島傳說的謎團。

scripts.text: Ah, one more thing! Look around that scholar and you should find his ^3355FFJournal^000000. I promise that it will be an interesting read.
scripts.translation: 啊，還有一件事！在那位學者附近找找，應該^3355FF能發現^000000他的日記。我保證讀起來很有意思。

scripts.text: When the winds die, may your dreams fill your sails~ Good luck to you!
scripts.translation: 當風停息時，願你的夢想填滿你的風帆~ 祝你好運！

scripts.text: I may not know much, but I won't talk to anyone motivated solely by greed. Go home!
scripts.translation: 我雖然知道得不多，但我不會跟那些只被貪婪驅動的人說話。回家去吧！

scripts.text: If you go to eastern side of the Alberta port, you should find an old ferryboatman.
scripts.translation: 如果你去艾爾貝塔港的東邊，應該能找到一位老船伕。

scripts.text: His name is ^3355FFGotanblue^000000. I believe he may know a way to Turtle Island. Heh heh, good luck~
scripts.translation: 他叫戈^3355FF坦布魯，^000000或許知道去海龜島的路。嘿嘿，祝你好運~

scripts.text: My, that place is difficult to find and even more difficult to travel to. You're sure you want to go? I would love to give you some advice, but I feel so dizzy after drinking so much...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，那個地方很難找到，更難到達。你確定要去嗎？我很想給你一些建議，但喝了這麼多酒，我感覺好暈啊...

scripts.text: Why don't you talk to a chubby little sailor I know named ^3355FFGotanblue^000000. You can find him loitering on one of the Alberta ports.
scripts.translation: 不如去和我認識的一個胖乎乎的小水手聊聊^3355FF，他叫戈坦^000000布魯。你可以在艾爾貝塔港的某個地方找到他。

scripts.text: Tell him that I sent you, and he may tell you more about Turtle Island. He may even know how to get there~
scripts.translation: 告訴他是我派你來的，他可能會告訴你更多關於海龜島的事。他甚至可能知道怎麼去那裡~

scripts.text: how I can drink so much...
scripts.translation: 我都不明白自己怎麼能喝這麼多...

scripts.text: I can tell you're curious about Turtle Island. I guess you must have been talking to that drunken old man!
scripts.translation: 看你的眼神，我就知道你對海龜島好奇。你一定和那個醉醺醺的老頭聊過了吧！

scripts.text: Do you know about Turtle Island?
Well, first I think it's fair to warn you that Turtle Island took the lives of my buddies. That's right, I was part of ^3355FFJornadan Niliria^000000's crew.
scripts.translation: ？先提醒你，那裡奪走了我許多夥伴的性命。沒錯，我曾是約爾納丹·^3355FF尼利里亞船隊^000000的一員。

scripts.text: We wanted to find out if the legends about that island were true, so we left everything behind to learn the truth.
scripts.translation: 我們想弄清楚關於那個島嶼的傳說是否屬實，所以我們拋下一切，去探尋真相。

scripts.text: Jornadan Niliria was one of the greatest treasure hunters ever, and he gathered men for his crew from around the globe. I'm proud to say that each member of our crew was the best in his field.
scripts.translation: 約爾納丹·尼利里亞是史上最偉大的尋寶者之一，從世界各地招募船員。我們每個人都是各自領域的佼佼者。

scripts.text: I happened to be the best at navigating. I was only twenty, but I was still invited to his team. It was such an honor to be accepted as an equal amongst these great men.
scripts.translation: 我最擅長領航。當時我只有二十歲，卻受邀加入他的團隊。能與這些傑出人物並肩，真是莫大的榮幸。

scripts.text: Anyway, our biggest clue about Turtle Island's location hinted that it was near Alberta, so our voyage began from here.
scripts.translation: 總之，關於海龜島位置的最大線索暗示它就在艾爾貝塔附近，所以我們的航行從這裡開始。

scripts.text: We sailed day and night, drifting for weeks, until one day, we were surrounded by an incredibly thick fog. We had no idea of which direction we were going and the mist wouldn't clear.
scripts.translation: 我們日夜航行，漂流了數週。一天，我們被濃霧包圍，完全辨不清方向，霧也遲遲不散。

scripts.text: But none of us had any regrets and we just kept moving onward. There would be no turning back!
scripts.translation: 但我們誰都沒有後悔，只是繼續前行。絕不回頭！

scripts.text: Finally, a coral reef sudden appeared and we couldn't steer away from it. Our ship was critically damaged. But when the fog cleared, we saw that we had finally arrived at Turtle Island! It was real!
scripts.translation: 終於，一片珊瑚礁突然出現在前方，我們來不及避開，船也嚴重受損。霧散之後，我們發現終於抵達了海龜島！它真的存在！

scripts.text: After we made camp on shore and explored the island, we learned something quite remarkable.
scripts.translation: 我們在岸上紮營並探索了島嶼，隨後發現了一件相當驚人的事情。

scripts.text: There was a man who had actually made it to Turtle Island before us. His records, however, never reached Rune-Midgarts. He was a great swordmaster known simply as ^3355FFOne^000000.
scripts.translation: 有個男人比我們更早抵達海龜島，但他的記錄從未傳回盧恩·米德加茲。他是位偉大的劍術大師，人們只^3355FF稱他為^000000一。

scripts.text: According to his records, he had traveled alone to find Turtle Island and made it by himself. But we couldn't find any sign of him anywhere...
scripts.translation: 根據他的記錄，他獨自出發尋找海龜島，也獨自抵達了那裡。可我們到處都找不到他...

scripts.text: As we explored Turtle Island further, we learned that not only was it abundant with treasure, but that it also held an item of great interest.
scripts.translation: 進一步探索後，我們發現島上不僅遍佈寶藏，還有一件特別引人注目的東西。

scripts.text: From the first explorer's record, some kind of amazing ^3355FFjewel fragment^000000 was mentioned.
scripts.translation: 根據第一位探險者的記錄，那裡似^3355FF乎有一塊神奇^000000的寶石碎片。

scripts.text: He had traveled to Turtle Island with the purpose of discovering secrets to the sword arts, and stumbled upon a jewel he claimed was the most beautiful in the world.
scripts.translation: 他為了探尋劍術的奧秘來到海龜島，偶然發現了一塊寶石，還說那是世上最美的寶石。

scripts.text: By the ^3355FFOne^000000's records, we were able to thoroughly explore all to be seen on Turtle Island. However...
scripts.translation: 根^3355FF據一的^000000記錄，我們得以徹底探索海龜島。不過...

scripts.text: Even after months of searching, we could never find a trace of the jewel fragment. Eventually, we had to give up on our search.
scripts.translation: 搜尋數月，我們始終沒找到寶石碎片的蹤跡，最後只好放棄。

scripts.text: Finally, we packed our things to leave the island. But then, as we were traveling at sea, we encountered a thick, blinding fog once again.
scripts.translation: 最後我們收拾行裝準備離島。可在海上航行時，又遇上了那片濃霧。

scripts.text: We spent a month trying to steer through that mist. When we finally sailed out of that mist, we saw that we had arrived at the other side of Turtle Island!
scripts.translation: 我們花了一個月試圖穿過迷霧。終於駛出時，發現自己竟繞到了海龜島的另一側！

scripts.text: Our spirits were crushed!! We tried again and again to leave that place, and spent nearly a year trying to leave but we kept winding up at Turtle Island's shores.
scripts.translation: 我們幾乎絕望了！！一次又一次試圖離島，折騰了將近一年，卻總是回到海龜島的岸邊。

scripts.text: As we struggled with the fog, we lost our comrades one by one. In the end, Jornadan, the drunken old man you met, and myself were the only ones who were able to return home to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 在與迷霧周旋的過程中，同伴一個接一個地死去。最後只有你見過的那個醉老頭約爾納丹和我活著回到了艾爾貝塔。

scripts.text: We were the only ones who did not give in to despair, and doggedly held onto our hopes. Still, it was by pure luck that we found a way back to Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 我們始終沒有絕望，頑強地懷抱希望。即便如此，能回到盧恩·米德加茲也純屬運氣。

scripts.text: Well, that's my story. You know, if you want to learn more about Turtle Island, why don't you speak to the scholar on the eastern port of Alberta?
scripts.translation: 好了，這就是我的故事。想了解更多海龜島的事，就去艾爾貝塔東港找那位學者談談吧。

scripts.text: I'm sure he can tell give you details that even I wouldn't be able to provide...
scripts.translation: 他肯定能告訴你一些連我也不知道的細節...

scripts.text: After my story of Turtle Island, you're still not afraid of going? I'm impressed! Alright then...
scripts.translation: 聽了我的海龜島故事，你竟然還一點都不害怕？真讓我佩服！好吧...

scripts.text: If you wish for me to guide you there, I will charge you 10,000 zeny. I'm the only navigator that can guide you there and back safely.
scripts.translation: 要我帶你去的話，收費10,000 Zeny。我是唯一能安全帶你往返的領航員。

scripts.text: You've made your choice! With my experience, we will arrive without fail! I appreciate your spirit!
scripts.translation: 既然你決定了，我就憑經驗保證把你安全帶到！我很欣賞你的勇氣！

scripts.text: Sorry, but you don't have enough zeny. I hope you understand that I can let my expertise and experience be undervalued...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，你的Zeny不夠。我的專業和經驗可不能被低估，希望你能理解...

scripts.text: Well, if the spirit of adventure should happen to grab you, I will be here waiting.
scripts.translation: 等你再次燃起冒險之心，我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text: Come back whenever you feel you're ready to hear my story, will you?
scripts.translation: 等你準備好聽我的故事時，隨時回來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text: Just look at that ocean! It covers the earth as far as the eye can see. Tell me that's not one of the most beautiful things you've ever seen...
scripts.translation: ..看看那片大海！一望無際，延伸到天邊。這難道不是你見過的最美景色之一嗎？

scripts.text: I certainly hope you've found what you were looking for. Alright, I guess there's always a time for an adventurer to return home...
scripts.translation: 希望你找到了想要的東西。好吧，冒險者總有回家的時候...

scripts.text: Even the great, ever expanding sky that's shared by all the peoples of the earth looks strange when you're in a new and foreign land.
scripts.translation: 即使是所有人共享的廣闊天空，身處陌生之地時，看起來也會不一樣。
就像我在海龜島的那段時光。
你是約爾納丹·尼利里亞？！

scripts.text: It's almost silly, but Turtle Island was named simply because it's shaped just like a turtle.
scripts.translation: 說來有點可笑，海龜島之所以叫這個名字，僅僅是因為它的形狀就像一隻海龜。

scripts.text: Now, Turtle Island is surrounded by a dense fog. When we were first stuck in it, a lot of us believed it was the result of a curse, or some kind of magic.
scripts.translation: 如今，海龜島被濃霧環繞。當我們最初被困在那裡時，很多人相信這是詛咒或某種魔法的結果。

scripts.text: But in actuality, the fog is the result of a natural phenomenon. It's created by a waterfall inside a cave located on Turtle Island's coast.
scripts.translation: 但實際上，這種霧是自然現象造成的。它是由海龜島海岸一處洞穴內的瀑布形成的。

scripts.text: Once you attain understanding, the truth becomes so simple. I guess confusion and fear is the fog that clouds your judgment, your path on life.
scripts.translation: 一旦你理解了，真相就變得如此簡單。我想，困惑和恐懼就是遮蔽你判斷、你人生道路的迷霧。

scripts.text: Believe it or not, I too used to fear the dangers of Turtle Island. But now that I understand most of its secrets, I look at my experiences at Turtle Island with fondness.
scripts.translation: 信不信由你，我也曾害怕海龜島的危險。但現在我瞭解了它的大部分秘密，我反而對在海龜島的經歷充滿了懷念。

scripts.text: Still, there is one thing I haven't yet uncovered. The ^3355FFunknown jewel fragment^000000.
scripts.translation: 不過，有一樣東西我至今還沒有發^3355FF現。未知的寶石碎^000000片。

scripts.text: So, until I find it, I'll keep researching and learn as much as I can until I do. Ha ha ha ha~!
scripts.translation: 所以，在找到它之前，我會繼續研究，儘可能多地瞭解它。Ha ha ha ha~!~！

scripts.text: I suppose that you know about my treasure hunting days, and probably about Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 我想你應該知道我的尋寶經歷，大概也聽說過海龜島。

scripts.text: Well, as you can see, I'm a little older now. These old bones aren't what they used to be.
scripts.translation: 你看，我現在年紀大了些。這把老骨頭可不如從前了。

scripts.text: But perhaps, someday, if my research bears fruit, I'll venture out once more and seek the one treasure I've never found...
scripts.translation: 不過也許有一天，如果我的研究有所收穫，我會再次出發，去尋找那件我從未找到的寶物...

scripts.text: When you want to discover the truth, never give in to despair. If you never give up your search, the answer will come to you.
scripts.translation: 當你想要發現真相時，永遠不要向絕望屈服。如果你永不放棄尋找，答案終會來到你面前。

scripts.text: By the way, I'm pretty hungry. Why doesn't Alberta have any good restaurants?! I hear they have good dimsum in Kunlun...
scripts.translation: 對了，我有點餓了。艾爾貝塔怎麼連一家像樣的餐廳都沒有？！聽說崑崙的小籠包很好吃...

scripts.text: If you find this letter, please don't disregard what you have read.
scripts.translation: XOVX -如果你發現了這封信，請不要忽視你所讀到的內容。

scripts.text: Although we have found Turtle Island, it seems our expedition will fail.
scripts.translation: 雖然我們找到了海龜島，但我們的探險似乎要失敗了。

scripts.text: Only half of our crew is left, and we only have enough food for ten more days. Our condition is truly grave.
scripts.translation: 船員只剩下了一半，而且我們只夠吃十天的食物。我們的處境非常嚴峻。

scripts.text: This damn island must be cursed. There's nothing to eat and we're so close to starving!
scripts.translation: 該死的島肯定是被詛咒了。這裡沒有任何食物，我們快要餓死了！

scripts.text: If we don't get help or find Alberta soon...
scripts.translation: 如果我們不能儘快得到援助或找到艾爾貝塔...

scripts.text: There's no light from the stars tonight, and we can't even see a hundred meters ahead of us. The men seem to feel something bad in the air.
scripts.translation: 今晚看不見星光，前方連一百米都看不清。船員們似乎都感覺到空氣中瀰漫著不祥的氣息。

scripts.text: The faces of my comrades betrayed their fears. They couldn't manage to sleep last night. I hope we will see sunrise soon...
scripts.translation: 同伴們的臉上寫滿了恐懼。他們昨晚都失眠了。希望我們很快能看到日出...

scripts.text: 5 minutes ago, our comrade, Cooker, was killed when the mast suddenly cracked and fell on his head.
scripts.translation: 五分鐘前，我們的同伴庫克被突然斷裂的桅杆砸中頭部，不幸身亡。

scripts.text: The estimated time of death is 04:07. The mast broke due to the shock of the ship hitting a reef. The left side of the deck also suffered from serious damage.
scripts.translation: 預計死亡時間為04:07。桅杆是因為船撞擊暗礁的衝擊而斷裂的。甲板左側也受到了嚴重損壞。

scripts.text: While two of our workers were fixing the bottom of the deck, they were attacked by monsters that had snuck through cracks in the deck.
scripts.translation: 兩名工人正在修補甲板底部時，被從甲板縫隙中鑽進來的魔物襲擊了。

scripts.text: These two were lost in the attack. The estimated time of death was 04:32. Fortunately, we are able to stay afloat, but we must hurry and find land.
scripts.translation: 這兩人在襲擊中喪生。預計死亡時間為04:32。幸運的是，船還能漂浮，但我們必須加快速度尋找陸地。

scripts.text: From the damage to the deck, we've lost 30% of our supplies. At this rate, we'll run out of food soon.
scripts.translation: 由於甲板受損，我們損失了30%的補給品。照這個速度下去，我們的食物很快就會耗盡。

scripts.text: There seem to be more and more reefs to steer around, and they are growing larger as we travel. I wonder if we'll find land soon...
scripts.translation: 需要繞行的暗礁似乎越來越多，而且隨著航行的推進，它們也越來越大。不知道我們能不能很快找到陸地...
長 約爾納丹·尼利里亞

scripts.text: Just after we arrived on Turtle Island, we frantically searched all over for food.
scripts.translation: 剛到達海龜島後，我們瘋狂地到處尋找食物。

scripts.text: It was so bad, that you could see the bones through our skin.
scripts.translation: 情況非常糟糕，我們瘦得皮包骨頭。

scripts.text: We found some kind of fruit to eat! It's covered in some sort of yellow skin and looks like a banana!
scripts.translation: 我們找到了一種可以吃的果實！它外面包著黃色的皮，看起來像香蕉！

scripts.text: Well, it wasn't exactly like the bananas we have in Rune-Midgarts, but it was very similar.
scripts.translation: 嗯，它和盧恩·米德加茲的香蕉不太一樣，但非常相似。

scripts.text: In the middle of the night, one of the men reported that he felt sick after eating the food.
scripts.translation: 半夜裡，一名船員報告說，吃了那些食物後感到噁心。

scripts.text: Another crew member, Berot Berot, was also found to have severe indigestion.
scripts.translation: 另一名船員貝羅特·貝羅特也被發現患有嚴重的消化不良。

scripts.text: It's now becoming very clear that the food we have been eating contains some kind of poison.
scripts.translation: 現在越來越清楚，我們一直吃的食物裡含有某種毒素。

scripts.text: The third person to experience indigestion passed away today. We are all very worried.
scripts.translation: 第三名出現消化不良症狀的人今天去世了。我們都非常擔心。

scripts.text: Our suspicions were confirmed when we found that the animals on Turtle Island wouldn't eat the bananas we found.
scripts.translation: 當我們發現海龜島上的動物不吃我們找到的香蕉時，我們的懷疑得到了證實。

scripts.text: We decided to seal away this poisonous fruit, but learned that it didn't rot, not even after we removed the skin.
scripts.translation: 我們決定封存這種有毒的水果，但發現它不會腐爛，即使剝去果皮也是如此。

scripts.text: We have no idea why it's harmful to eat, or why it never perishes, but it be of some medical or scientific interest.
scripts.translation: 我們不知道這種水果為什麼有毒，也不知道它為什麼永不腐壞，但或許能用於醫學或科學研究。

scripts.text: In the meantime, we've decided to bury this fruit until we can get back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 在此期間，我們決定將這種水果埋起來，直到我們回到艾爾貝塔。

scripts.text: ^3355FFIn the Voyage log is a thin key marked with a skull. You've taken this Skull key, as it may be of some use later.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF航海日誌中夾著一把刻有骷髏圖案的細鑰匙。你拿走了骷髏鑰匙，也許以後能派上用^000000場。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou notice a page with a stamp shaped like a bird's foot. The black ink smells sort of like fruit.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你注意到一頁紙上蓋著鳥爪形狀的印章，黑色墨水聞起來有股水果^000000味。

scripts.text: We've found evidence that other people were here, and that we are not the first to find Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 我們發現其他人曾經來過這裡的證據，看來海龜島並非由我們首次發現。

scripts.text: There was at least one person who made it here before us. Hopefully, his records are on the island somewhere.
scripts.translation: 至少有一個人比我們更早抵達這裡。希望能在島上找到他的記錄。

scripts.text: Starting tomorrow, we will begin searching for these hidden records.
scripts.translation: 從明天開始，我們要尋找那些被藏起來的記錄。

scripts.text: We are having difficulty trying to find any records. Is it possible that the first people here wrote nothing of their journey?
scripts.translation: 一直找不到任何記錄。難道第一批來到這裡的人什麼都沒寫下嗎？

scripts.text: We finally found the records we have been searching for.
scripts.translation: 我們終於找到了要找的記錄。

scripts.text: His notes were so hard to find because only one man, rather than a whole team, came to Turtle Island before us!
scripts.translation: 他的筆記如此難找，是因為比我們更早來到海龜島的只有一個人，而不是一支隊伍！

scripts.text: This man was a swordsman simply known as 'One.' His records tell much about what can be found on Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 這名男子是位劍士，人們只稱他為“一”。他的記錄詳細記載了海龜島上的所見。

scripts.text: His records were written on animals skin, but they were durable and still easy to read after all this time.
scripts.translation: 他的記錄寫在動物皮上，十分耐用，經過這麼久仍清晰可讀。

scripts.text: According to his notes, Turtle Island consists of 4 levels. Although there are no people here, but there are many traps and devices which operate through a mysterious force.
scripts.translation: 根據他的筆記，海龜島共有4層。島上雖無人居住，卻有許多依靠神秘力量運作的陷阱和裝置。

scripts.text: Still, it is certain that something has some control over Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 不過，可以確定有某種力量在控制著海龜島。

scripts.text: To keep this record safe, our crew has decided to hide this valuable record on the second level of Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 為了妥善保管這份記錄，我們決定把它藏在海龜島第二層。

scripts.text: ^3355FFThere is a picture of a tree in which there is a small keyhole clearly shown under the roots.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF有一幅樹的圖畫，樹根下方清楚畫著一個小鑰匙^000000孔。

scripts.text: ^3355FFThese pages of this log are soiled with mud, and some of them are missing.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF日誌的幾頁沾滿泥巴，還有幾頁不見了^000000。

scripts.text: The greatest treasure of Turtle Island, the likes of which have never been seen, is hidden, sealed in some secret place...
scripts.translation: 海龜島上有一件前所未見的最大寶藏，被封存在某個秘密地點...

scripts.text: We have spent many days searching for it, but found not one trace.
scripts.translation: 我們花了很多天尋找，卻連一點蹤跡都沒找到。

scripts.text: In the meantime, we've collected many precious treasures. We've decided to take only some of it back home, and to leave the rest here.
scripts.translation: 這段時間我們收集了許多珍寶。我們決定只帶一部分回家，其餘留在島上。

scripts.text: We have hidden the treasure we have left behind to keep it from getting stolen.
scripts.translation: 為了防止被盜，我們把留下的寶藏藏了起來。

scripts.text: It is somewhere on the fourth level, the bottom of the island. The treasure is sealed in a box that is a relic from an ancient culture.
scripts.translation: 寶藏在島嶼最底層，也就是第四層，裝在一個古代文明遺留下來的箱子裡。

scripts.text: However, the technology of this treasure box is very sophisticated, and it won't be easy to open by force.
scripts.translation: 不過，這個寶箱的機關十分精密，想強行開啟並不容易。

scripts.text: This turtle pillar is made of the strongest material on this island.
scripts.translation: 這座海龜柱子是由島上最堅固的材料製成的。

scripts.text: Cutting it is impossible for even someone with legendary skills. Even if I managed to cut it, all of Turtle Island would collapse upon me.
scripts.translation: 即使是擁有傳奇技藝的人也無法將其切開。即便我成功將其切開，整個海龜島也會隨之崩塌。

scripts.text: I've developed my mental skills, and trained using materials on this island. Sharpening my mind, I now know that I can cut this pillar in two.
scripts.translation: 我磨練精神，並以島上的材料為訓練物件。如今心智堅定，我知道自己能將這根柱子一分為二。

scripts.text: Can this be the pinnacle of swordsmanship? Of the sword arts?
scripts.translation: 這難道就是劍術的巔峰嗎？是劍道的極致嗎？

scripts.text: For this final accomplishment, I leave behind an offering.
scripts.translation: 為了這最後的成就，我留下了一份供品。

scripts.text: I intend to offer my gratitude to the blood of the monsters I have killed, and the materials I have used in my training.
scripts.translation: 我想感謝那些被我擊敗的魔物，也感謝訓練中用到的材料，所以留下這份供品。

How dare you speak to me in that tone! Don't you know who I am?! I'm Takuyaka, leader of the Security Knights of Alberta! Kobolds and Porings quiver in fear when they hear my name...
scripts.translation: 你竟敢用這種語氣跟我說話！你不知道我是誰嗎？！我是拓也香，艾爾貝塔保安騎士團團長！犬妖和波利聽到我的名字都會嚇得發抖...

scripts.text: So tell me the truth! You came here for treasure, didn't you?! You want it all for yourself! You bastard! Now get off this island! Go, shoo!
scripts.translation: 老實交代！你是來尋寶的，對吧？！想獨吞所有寶物！你這個混蛋！立刻離開這座島！走，快走！

scripts.text: Well, your name sounds better than mine. And you have more hair on your head as well. Hmmm...
scripts.translation: 嗯，你的名字聽起來比我的好聽，頭髮也比我多。嗯...

scripts.text: Do you have anything to give me? You know, some food or zeny? It's not like I really need it, it's just... Oh bother. Never mind. Perhaps we'll meet later.
scripts.translation: 你有什麼東西可以給我嗎？比如食物或Zeny？其實我也不是真的需要，只是...算了。也許我們以後還會見面。

scripts.text: I've heard that many treasures can be found on Turtle Island. If I can take enough home, I'll be rich! Well, we're supposed to rescue lost adventurers too, but whatever. As leader, I can do whatever I want!
scripts.translation: 我聽說海龜島上有很多寶藏。要是能帶夠多回去，我就發財了！雖然我們本該救援迷路的冒險者...算了，身為團長，我想做什麼就做什麼！

scripts.text: However, we're totally lost. Meaning we can't find any treasure or even rescue any people. Grrr...! Where are my useless soldiers! I've probably spoiled them with too much food!
scripts.translation: 不過我們完全迷路了，既找不到寶藏，也救不了任何人。可惡...！我那群沒用計程車兵在哪兒？！大概是平時給他們吃太好，把他們慣壞了！

scripts.text: If you see any of them, tell them they must assemble here! Alright?!
scripts.translation: 如果你看到我的人，就叫他們到這裡集合！聽到了嗎？！

scripts.text: Me? I'm Takuyaka. A tall, dark, handsome, and dashing leader, as well as a fearsome knight! I have come to save the foolish people of Alberta that have come seeking treasure on Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 我？我是拓也香，高大、黝黑、英俊瀟灑的團長，也是一位令人聞風喪膽的騎士！我來拯救那些跑來海龜島尋寶的艾爾貝塔居民。

scripts.text: Anyway, we came here with the purest of intents. But right when we arrived, we were attacked by monsters! Because of the confusion from all the fighting, my soldiers were scattered.
scripts.translation: 總之，我們懷著最純粹的目的來到這裡。可剛一上島就遭到魔物襲擊！混戰之中，我計程車兵們四散了。
為什麼這種事會發生在我身上！！！！
艾爾貝塔保安騎士團的副團長。

scripts.text: We've come here to rescue treasure hunters that might be in trouble. However, our leader is this porky specimen right next to me. So I guess I foresaw that this mission would fail.
scripts.translation: 我們來這裡是為了救援遇險的尋寶者。可我們的團長偏偏是旁邊這個肥豬。我早就料到任務會失敗。

scripts.text: Basically, our leader was so distracted by the idea of finding treasure himself that we've lost our men. It's bad enough that he's a fat slob, but he's a greedy slob too!
scripts.translation: 團長光顧著自己尋寶，害得我們和士兵走散了。他不光是個邋遢胖子，還貪得無厭！

scripts.text: Oh hey! You're an adventurer, aren't you? Do you know where my comrades are?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你是冒險者吧？你知道我的同伴們在哪兒嗎？

scripts.text: My name is Passats, a proud Security Knight of Alberta. We've obtained some information that some people came here to seek treasure.
scripts.translation: 我是帕薩茨，艾爾貝塔保安騎士團的一員。我們得到情報，說有人來這裡尋寶。

scripts.text: Our task here is to save people, but when we arrived on Turtle Island, we were attacked by a mob of monsters! So we all got scattered.
scripts.translation: 我們的任務是救人，但剛到海龜島就遭到一群魔物襲擊！結果大家都走散了。

scripts.text: Now I'm all alone. If you find anyone else in my unit, would you let them know?
scripts.translation: 現在只剩我一個人。如果你找到我小隊的其他人，能告訴他們我的位置嗎？

scripts.text: Well, if you happen to find anyone else in my unit, would you let them know where I am?
scripts.translation: 如果你碰巧找到我小隊的其他人，能讓他們知道我在哪嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, and if you find our leader, kick his butt, will you? It's so fat, there's no way you can miss.
scripts.translation: 對了，要是找到團長，幫我揍他一頓好嗎？他那麼胖，你肯定一眼就能認出來。

scripts.text: There are a lot of stories about the amazing wealth that can be found on this island. However, everyone assumed that it was impossible to find Turtle Island.
scripts.translation: 關於島上藏著驚人財富的傳說很多，但以前大家都以為根本找不到海龜島。

scripts.text: But then, the problem began when some navigator actually knew the way to Turtle Island. I think he'll take just about anybody for 10,000 zeny!
scripts.translation: 後來問題來了，有個領航員竟然知道去海龜島的路。我想只要10,000 Zeny，他什麼人都肯帶！

scripts.text: So anyway, some of the people of Alberta have been foolishly coming here, hoping to find treasure. But of course, they can't fight monsters.
scripts.translation: 總之，艾爾貝塔有些人傻乎乎地跑來尋寶，結果根本打不過魔物。

scripts.text: So now we're here in order to seek out towners in trouble, and send them safely back home. Of course, now it seems that we also need rescuing...

scripts.text: Oh, don't be angry. I just drank too much vodka! Before we arrived I was still unconscious and when I finally sobered up, I was here. I'm so embarrassed~

scripts.text: Oh? Are you a civilian? Nice to meet you. I'm a mighty Security Knight of Alberta, Jayprocat.
scripts.translation: 哦？你是平民嗎？很高興認識你。我是艾爾貝塔保安騎士團的傑普羅卡特，實力強悍！

scripts.text: We're supposed to protect the people of Alberta. That's our job as proud Security Knights.
scripts.translation: 我們本該保護艾爾貝塔的人民。這就是保安騎士團的職責。

scripts.text: So when a bunch of them caught treasure fever and started coming here, we came to rescue them. Anyway, that was the plan.
scripts.translation: 所以一群人染上尋寶熱，跑來這裡時，我們就來救援了。原本計劃是這樣的。

scripts.text: It turns out that by some joke by fate, our leader is this pudgy guy who attracted a mob on monsters to us by noisily digging up treasure, instead of doing what we were supposed to do.
scripts.translation: 沒想到命運開了個玩笑：我們的團長是個胖乎乎的傢伙。他不幹正事，反而大聲挖寶，引來一群魔物襲擊我們。

scripts.text: Why wasn't Mudasamu in charge? With him as leader, I would've been home for dinner...
scripts.translation: 為什麼不是穆達薩姆負責？他要是團長，我早就回家吃晚飯了...

scripts.text: It's true that we pretty much messed up our current mission to save anyone here seeking for treasure, since we need rescuing now as well.

scripts.text: Why did we have to be attacked by so many monsters on my first mission? I'm... I'm just a new recruit...
